### **__Fixed spawns__**

__Fixed spawns__

**Vault 51**

Scorched Wendigo spawn.

From the Atrium, stay on the bottom floor and head over to the North corner of the room. Enter the dining room and open the door on your right. You will find the Scorched Wendigo in the gambling room.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_050b13aa360d4920bed17b53fec43c42~mv2.jpg)

**Transmission Station 1AT-U03**

Scorched Wendigo spawn.

You will need to have completed the original Enclave questline to be able to enter this location. Hacker and Lock Pick perk cards or Master Infiltrator will help a lot here as well.

From the main lobby, face NE and use either the terminal or lock pick to unlock the white door on the left. Follow the corridor around until you get to a room with a green poisonous cloud. You can either jump into Power Armour, a Chinese Stealth Suit or just YOLO it through the cloud. Keep following the path around until you get to a room with a Scorched Mothman in it.

Kill the Mothman and then follow the catwalk around on your right. Keep following the platform around until you see a door marked "Exit". Walk through that door and follow the path around until you get to another lab. The Wendigo will jump out at you from the top floor of the lab.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6837d36a3653485fafc8b85d23fd8bf9~mv2.jpg)

**Wendigo Cave**

Glowing Wendigo spawn.

Follow the cave to the end and take care against the level 100 Mirelurk Kings.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_853fc6db523f43649635c78b819369b9~mv2.jpg)

**Abby's Bunker**

1 to 3 Glowing Wendigo.

From the spawn-in point, turn East and follow the path down to the main road. Turn right and follow the road down until you see a ute/pickup truck and horse trailer hanging from a tree in the middle of the road.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bb9f4d49485740b7b5477f8772e44f15~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3c3a288a61ca4c9c85d11268a586e171~mv2.jpg)

### **__Chance to spawn__**

__Chance to spawn__

There is a 1/3 chance for a Wendigo to spawn at the below locations, providing your character is over level 50. If you are under level 50 then your chances become lower.

If you are over level 50 and in the Nuke Zone then there is still a 1/3 chance for a Wendigo to spawn.

**Forest**

- Transmission station 1AT-U03 - Internal
- Kanawha Nuka-Cola Plant - Internal

**Ash Heap**

- AMS Testing Site
- Garrahan Estate - Top Floor
- Lewisburg
- Pylon Ambush Site
- Sal's Grinder

**Savage Divide**

- Monongah Power Plant - Internal
- Wendigo Cave - Internal

**The Mire**

- Freddy Fear's House of Scares
- Haven Church
- KMAX Transmission

**Cranberry Bog**

- Appalachian Antiques
- Drop Site G3
- Firebase Major
- Fort Defiance - Internal
- Forward Station Delta

### **__Events and Pip-Boy Dailys__**

__Events and Pip-Boy Dailys__

**A Colossal Problem**

Nuke __Monongah Mine__ to start this event and 100s of Wendigo will spawn.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b45499039c324ee98bff53f72d41c7c3~mv2.jpg)

**One Violent Night**

A Wendigo will spawn at the end of the event.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_33da52e9925741daaacaffa504cbf8ba~mv2.jpg)

**Queen of the Hunt**

1/6 chances to spawn at one of the Investigate sites.

This daily can be started the first time, by visiting the __Hunter's Shack__ in The Mire. After completing the daily the first time, it will trigger by just fast traveling into the region. Pip-Boy daily cool-down periods apply. 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f76267c4c17f4dfb9b6eb6a7fb47d1ce~mv2.jpg)
